title: Heavenly Fate is Mine
next_chapter_hook: Ten thousand years later, when new cultivators unfold the yellowed ancient scrolls, what they see is not merely a prophecy, but the legend of a mortal who spent an entire lifetime rewriting heavenly fate.

text.content: Within the Void, Mo Xiansheng's remnant soul emanated a faint blue glow, those eyes that had witnessed ten thousand years now filled with complex emotions. He raised his hand, and an enigmatic rune materialized before Chen Ji's eyes—a bloodline mark never before seen, as if heavenly fate was carved into his very bones and blood. "Your father was no ordinary man." Mo Xiansheng's voice carried a trembling unseen for a thousand years. "He was the previous master of the Tianji Record, a rebel erased by the Eye of Heavenly Dao. The heavenly fate blood within you is his final legacy, and the true reason you can bear the Tianji Record."

dialogue.content: Chen Ji listened quietly, yet his aura grew increasingly serene, as if hearing a story that had nothing to do with him. He gazed at his own palm, where the heavenly fate blood faintly pulsed with a golden light. "So... the废物physique I always thought I had was a lie from the beginning?" he asked softly, even a self-deprecating smile forming at the corner of his mouth. "Heh, that actually saved me quite a bit of explaining."

text.content: Mo Xiansheng fell silent for a moment, his remnant soul dimming slightly: "The Tianji Record chose you for a reason. Your father was defeated by the Eye of Heavenly Dao because he was too obsessed with resistance. But you..." he paused, "You hid your brilliance beneath a废物persona, resolved crises through chess-like strategies, and exchanged minimum cost for maximum gain. This is the master the Tianji Record truly needs—not a brute force resister, but a chess player who conquers through wisdom."

dialogue.content: Mo Xiansheng's remnant soul began to fade slowly, yet he cast one final glance at Chen Ji, and unexpectedly, a hint of a smile appeared in his eyes: "The Tianji Record is now complete, and the heavenly fate blood within you has fully awakened. From now on, you are no longer a chess piece—you are the chess player. Lad, go. Go see who in this world still dares to call you废物."

text.content: As his words fell, the Tianji Record burst forth with dazzling golden light, as brilliant as the dawn of morning, illuminating the entire space until it became transparent. Chen Ji felt something within him completely awaken—it was the bloodline power left by his father, as well as the final shackle of the Tianji Record recognizing its master. Countless visions of the future flickered in his eyes, but this time, all threads of destiny were firmly in his own hands.

dialogue.content: Sudden hurried footsteps echoed from outside the hall. Su Qingyao rushed in wearing a plain white long dress, her eyes slightly reddened, clearly having waited for a long time. "Chen Ji!" She called his name so uncharacteristically for the first time, her voice carrying a long-suppressed tremor. "Do you know how long I've been waiting? From the moment you entered this forbidden grounds, I've been waiting outside, I..." Her voice choked.

text.content: Chen Ji turned around, looking at this woman who had approached him as an investigator but ultimately became his most steadfast guardian. He suddenly smiled, that smile devoid of his usual scheming and pretense, only the shyness and tenderness of an ordinary boy facing his beloved. "Senior Sister Su, sorry for the long wait." he said softly, then did something no one expected—he stepped forward and gently pulled Su Qingyao into his embrace.

dialogue.content: Su Qingyao's body stiffened for a moment, then completely softened in his arms, her arms tightly wrapping around him in return. Her voice was muffled against his chest: "You bastard... hiding for so many years, deceiving me for so many years... yet I simply cannot do anything about you..." Her tears soaked his garment. "Don't hide things from me anymore from now on, you hear me?"

text.content: Chen Ji gently stroked her long hair, whispering near her ear: "Alright, from now on we share one fate, no more secrets." As his words fell, an enigmatic rune materialized between the two of them—the 'Shared Fate' contract bestowed by the Tianji Record—from this moment on, their destinies were intertwined completely, sharing life and death, fortune and misfortune together.

dialogue.content: At the hall's entrance, a wisp of dark demonic energy quietly dissipated, and Ye Qing's figure appeared at the boundary between light and shadow. She gazed at the embracing couple, a complex emotion flickering in her eyes, but quickly let it go. "Chen Ji, I've come to fulfill my promise." Her voice regained its usual cold detachment. "The Holy Sect of the Demonic Path is already crumbling; I should return. But before I leave, I will plant a hidden piece for you within the Holy Sect—if one day you need me, simply activate this demonic seal."

text.content: She handed a pitch-black demonic seal to Chen Ji, within which a wisp of her divine consciousness was sealed. "There's also..." Ye Qing hesitated briefly, rarely showing a trace of softness, "If one day you grow weary of the world's turmoil, come find me in the Demon Territory. I will wait for you there—not as an ally, but as..." She didn't finish, but the affection in her eyes spoke volumes.

dialogue.content: Just then, a crisp voice rang out from the Void: "Brother!" Chen Ji's body shuddered violently. He turned to look—Chen Nian's figure was flying over from the distance. She was no longer the frail little girl in his memory, but had grown into a young woman with a cold and elegant aura. Her eyes shimmered with tears, yet the corners of her mouth curved into the brightest smile: "Brother, I've returned!"

text.content: Chen Ji gazed at his now graceful younger sister, his throat suddenly tightening. That little girl who had always cowered behind him in his memories was now capable of standing on her own. He stepped forward, pulling Chen Nian into his embrace, his voice somewhat hoarse: "I'm sorry... it's this brother who came late." Chen Nian shook her head, tears soaking his garment: "Not late... as long as I can see Brother again, it's never too late..."

However, just at this moment, the Void suddenly quivered violently, and a transcendent pressure descended from the nine heavens. The will of the Eye of Heavenly Dao had arrived. "Chen Ji." That voice was vast and boundless, as if the entire Heavenly Dao itself was speaking. "Do you think rewriting fate allows you to escape the chessboard? How laughable... You have merely changed methods to become a new chess piece."

choice.prompt: The Eye of Heavenly Dao's pressure enveloped heaven and earth. Chen Ji faced his final choice—how should he respond to this transcendent existence?

choices.description: Using the power of the complete Tianji Record to face the Eye of Heavenly Dao head-on, displaying the true strength of a chess player.
choices.visible_reward: Completely shatter the Eye of Heavenly Dao's will projection

dialogue.content: Chen Ji released Su Qingyao and Chen Nian, stepping forward. His eyes held not the slightest fear, but instead blazed with unprecedented fighting intent. "The Eye of Heavenly Dao?" He coldly smiled, lifting his hand, the Tianji Record manifesting as a solid object in his palm. "Did you think I spent all this time plotting just to become your chess piece once more?"

choices.description: Using his own heavenly fate blood as the guide, summon the final legacy left by his father, and perish together with the Eye of Heavenly Dao.

dialogue.content: Chen Ji suddenly laughed, that smile carrying determination and relief. He turned to glance at Su Qingyao and Chen Nian one last time, whispering: "Wait for me." Then he turned to face the Eye of Heavenly Dao's pressure, the heavenly fate blood in his body beginning to boil and ignite. "Father... lend me your power one last time!"

text.content: Golden light collided violently with the Eye of Heavenly Dao's dark will, erupting with power sufficient to tear apart the heavens. The entire cultivation world felt that tremor in this moment—a confrontation between heavenly fate and Heavenly Dao, the ultimate game between chess piece and chess player. Chen Ji stood at the heart of the storm, the Tianji Record's power forming an absolute domain around him, blocking out the Eye of Heavenly Dao's will.

dialogue.content: "Impossible!" The Eye of Heavenly Dao's will let out a furious roar. "You are but a mortal body, how can you withstand such enormous heavenly fate power!" Chen Ji listened to that惊怒expressed by the once untouchable Heavenly Dao will, a faint serene smile appearing at the corner of his mouth: "Because I was never fighting alone."

text.content: Su Qingyao's shared fate power flowed into his body, Chen Nian's heavenly fate key power resonated with him, and even Ye Qing from the distant Demon Territory remotely activated that demonic seal, transmitting her power over. All bonds transformed in this moment into the purest of power, surging into the Tianji Record. "Do you see it?" Chen Ji's voice resounded across heaven and earth. "This is what you will never understand—the power of bonds!"

choice.prompt: The final strike is about to fall. How will Chen Ji choose to end this ten-thousand-year chess game?

choices.description: Completely obliterate the Eye of Heavenly Dao's will, rewriting Heavenly Dao laws from the root.
choices.visible_reward: Become the New Heavenly Dao Will

text.content: The Tianji Record emanated its ultimate light, that light transforming into a sword blade that pierced through the heavens, striking directly at the Eye of Heavenly Dao's core. "No—!" The Eye of Heavenly Dao's will let out its final scream, then completely dissipated within the sword light. Above the heavens, new laws began to operate—laws belonging to Chen Ji, laws of bonds and destiny.

choices.description: Do not completely destroy the Eye of Heavenly Dao, but instead reach a new pact with it, achieving coexistence between Heavenly Dao and destiny.
choices.risk_hint: The Eye of Heavenly Dao May Counterattack

text.content: Chen Ji put away the Tianji Record, extending his hand toward the Void: "I don't want to destroy you. I want you to submit to me. From now on, Heavenly Dao and destiny coexist. You and I shall jointly govern this world—but you are heaven, and I am master. Do you submit, or be destroyed?" The Eye of Heavenly Dao's will fell silent for a moment, then finally let out a sigh: "...I submit."

The storm clouds dispersed, and heaven and earth returned to tranquility. Chen Ji slowly descended beside Su Qingyao and Chen Nian. They each took one of his hands, their faces bearing the relief and joy of survivors. Not far away, Ye Qing's figure also appeared in the direction of the Demon Territory, nodding faintly at them from afar, then turned and vanished into the demonic mist. In the distance, the cheers of Tianqing Sect disciples rang out—it was a new dawn they had never witnessed before.

dialogue.content: Chen Ji gazed upon all of this, at the beloved and family by his side, at the sect and homeland in the distance. Suddenly he laughed softly. That laughter contained relief, satisfaction, and a通透ness that comes only after traversing the沧桑of life. "Senior Sister Su, Nian'er." he spoke, his voice uncharacteristically tender. "Let's go home."

text.content: Three figures walked side by side, stepping through the golden light of dawn, heading toward the Tianqing Sect. Their silhouettes were stretched long by the morning sun, as if extending into the endless future. And behind them, the Tianji Record floated quietly in the air, emanating a soft glow—that glow seemed to reflect countless possibilities, countless stories yet to unfold. Ten thousand years later, when new cultivators unfold the yellowed ancient scrolls, what they see is not merely a prophecy, but the legend of a mortal who spent an entire lifetime rewriting heavenly fate. Within that legend lies the patience of a废物disciple, the scheming of a chess player, bonds that transcend death itself, and most of all—the heroic spirit of heavenly fate belongs to me.
